observation.rationale: First real run (EURUSD 2024): complete setups peak at the London open (09-11 Madrid); the 02-04 windows caught 49 of 300.

liquidity.rationale_level_max_age: ~20 trading days; V1 levels never expired, so months-old swings stayed eligible sweep targets.

stop.rationale: V1 anchored the stop at the sweep extreme; 135 of 136 window-valid setups were rejected for stop > 3 ATR after two legs and a BOS.
